title: Glessner House can be 3D printed
items: Nothing you can see changed in the scene. A new export turns a building's model into a 3D-printable file: one watertight solid on a flat base, ready for a home printer.
Glessner House is the first: about 21 cm long at 1:250, with no lawn, vines or paving, and every railing, finial and downpipe thickened to at least 1 mm so a printer can lay it.
